title: I'm Easton
text: Welcome to my website, or as I like to call it, my little corner of the internet.

title: Smarty for {days} days
text: I maintain their product APIs, but on a more fun note, I built a haunted house detector for them and a game to promote rooftop geocoding.
alt: Easton Gibson in a location pin over a map, representing Smarty

title: A passion for robust software
text: I never stop building great software. This is a game I have published on both the App Store and Play Store.
alt: Briannas Game app icon: a ringed planet, a green dinosaur and a lipstick on a starry background

title: Beyond the Keyboard
text: First and foremost, I love my family, they are my world. I play the piano, read, and love watching movies. I'm also a reluctant runner who hasn't seen his last marathon. I collect Yu-Gi-Oh cards and love trading with Minecraft villagers. I'm a BYU Football fan. I run a lit YouTube channel called TierThat. I'm a Twenty One Pilots expert and love the world of Dune.
alt: Easton in a car wearing orange pixelated sunglasses and a backwards cap

title: What's Next?
text: I'm going to continue to create and build because I freaking love it. Check out my portfolio if you want to see what I've already built.
